rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a building’s entrance or reception area.

example.english: I’ll wait for you in the hotel lobby.

rows.note: Use this for an organized group that tries to influence public officials or government policy.

example.english: This lobby group has been pressuring the government to amend the law.
example.traditional: 呢個遊說團體近排不斷向政府施壓，要求修改條例。
